name: no-MCFD primary benchmark
description: Privacy-screened code and aggregate audit artifacts for family-disjoint nested evaluation of causal 2D-pose pre-impact fall warning under a prespecified event-level false-alarm budget. The release documents the no-MCFD primary benchmark, overlapping-window leakage diagnostic, budget sensitivity, same-protocol baselines, and reproducibility contracts. It contains no raw video, participant identifiers, restricted pose arrays, or trained checkpoints.
